notes.title: Green Energy Collector Second Generation Update Announcement
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Add updated test version levels
[*] Add guidance on updating the beginner gameplay interface
[*] Add a list of system language changes. The current game supports 5 languages, including Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Korean, and Japanese
[*] Increase mode frame rate display mode
[*] Optimize and update levels and some display bugs, such as: Initial version level introduction text, some players can only display English or Chinese characters, block characters, garbled characters, etc
[*] 
[/olist]
